mapper.sql: t.*, w.code AS workshop_code, w.name AS workshop_name, s.name AS shift_name, u.nickname AS leader_user_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mdm_team_member tm WHERE tm.team_id = t.id AND tm.deleted = 0) AS member_count

FROM mdm_team t LEFT JOIN mdm_workshop w ON w.id = t.workshop_id AND w.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN mdm_shift s ON s.id = t.shift_id AND s.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN system_users u ON u.id = t.leader_user_id AND u.deleted = 0
